description: SeFo is an Octave package by Nir Y. Krakauer for turning seasonal ensemble predictions into probabilistic forecasts. The publication documents modules for retrieving and reading observations and model output, fitting forecast distributions, and evaluating methods over chosen historical periods. Its stated application predicts monthly surface-air-temperature anomalies up to nine months ahead from the North American Multi-Model Ensemble. Geographic coverage follows the ensemble grids and observations selected by the user. The package can supply seasonal temperature scenarios for water and energy planning models. Version 0.0.2 remains publicly identified on Figshare, free under that archive's CC-BY-4.0 metadata; the paper states GPL-3.0-or-later for the software code. A limitation is that the former Bitbucket address now returns 404 and the archived runtime and data retrieval have not been tested. The differing licence declarations are retained for version-specific review. SeFo complements downstream demand or hydrological simulations. No archive or forecast data were downloaded.
